description: This file is a PHP source code for the class Opencart.Catalog.Controller.Account.Authorize, which manages user authorization functions such as login, send authorization tokens, validate tokens, unlock accounts, confirm authorization, reset authorization, and other related account authorization functionalities within the OpenCart platform.

classes.name: Authorize
classes.description: Controller class for managing account authorization operations such as login verification, sending authorization tokens, validation, unlocking accounts, confirmation, reset, and other authorization-related functionalities.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to load authorization page, checking cookies, and preparing data for the authorization view.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Handles sending authorization tokens, preparing JSON response for success or error messages.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the authorization token from cookies, checks authorization status, and handles errors or redirects accordingly.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Performs unlocking of the account related to authorization token, redirects if account is already valid.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Confirms authorization via code, possibly resets the authorization, and redirects accordingly.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets authorization status and code for a particular email or customer account.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a JSON response indicating success or failure of sending authorization.
